Blueberry Fizz
By: Claire Criscuolo, RN
Published: Saturday, June 9, 2012 - 3:50am

Ingredients




1  cup ice cubes
1  cup blueberry or black cherry herbal iced tea (brew fresh and keep in the frige for convenience)
1  8 oz bottle S. Pellegrino sparkling water
1/4 organic lemon

Preparation

1 Measure the ice cubes into a large glass, 16 oz or 20 oz glass 2 Pour in the iced tea 3 add the Pellegrino water 4 Squeeze the juice of the 1/4 lemon into the glass, then drop the squeezed lemon into the glass 5 Stir 6 Enjoy immediately:-)

About

This most refreshing drink is my "go-to" drink after a long day in the restaurant. It's thirst quenching, has a bit of Vitamin C and is virtually calorie free.

Comments:
Claire Criscuolo, RN
